title: console: record comments cannot be edited, deleted or replied to; `record:activity` declares `enableThreading: true` and no reply control renders (objectui#12211 item 5)
body:
Filing gate ①: a reproduced product defect, split from list card objectstack-ai/objectui#12211 (item 5) as triage `6121957396` directs ("The dispatching seat splits it per item into sub-issues"). This card carries item 5 only. With it every item of the parent is split, and the parent closes when every item is closed.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12211. Domain and priority are inherited from the parent (`domain:ui`, `priority:p3`); `area:records` per triage.
Reader: the `domain:ui` lane (either seat), from `pm:queue`.
Dedupe: the parent's table, item 5: `comment edit delete reply` (127 hits, none on point in the first page).

Triage's note for this item (`6121957396`), verbatim: "**Item 5:** the dev first reads what the spec declares for comment edit, delete and reply. `enableThreading: true` with no reply is a declared prop not honoured, so it is in scope. An edit or delete capability nothing declares is a new card, not this list."

## What happens (from the parent, item 5)

Source: the 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`), zh-CN.

- **Reach:** CASE-00041 (活动) and KA-0005 (讨论). Measured 2 of 2.
  - After `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment` → 201, the only control on the comment is 添加表情回应 (add reaction), plus 查看来源 (view source) on some entries.
  - `case_detail_page`'s `record:activity` sets `enableThreading: true`, yet no reply control renders.

## Acceptance

- Replies render where threading is enabled (the declared `enableThreading: true` is honoured), or the prop's declaration is corrected if threading is not supported.
- An author can edit and delete their own comment **only if** the spec declares that capability. If nothing declares it, that half is a new card, not this one (triage's note above).
